summary: Completed live API and browser regression testing for student and administrator flows.

issues: Metric cards initially display an em dash while /api/admin/metrics is loading, with no explicit loading or error state.

action_items: Consider a visible loading/error state for administrator metrics instead of a silent em dash.
Add try/catch or shared error handling around mutation API calls so failed requests do not become unhandled promise rejections.
critical_code_review_comments: Mutation handlers in App.js await axios calls without catch/finally states; network/API failures can leave the UI stale and produce unhandled promise rejections.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; existing demo database was exercised. Test flow created one QA Comunidad and toggled existing demo states.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bootstrap, profile persistence, connections, communities, event register/cancel, missions, role switch, admin metrics endpoint, and primary UI flows passed. Admin metric loading state and mutation error handling remain review recommendations.
rca of the issue: The admin component initializes metrics to null and uses metrics?.field || '—' while its request is in flight; this is a transient state rather than an API failure. Mutation callbacks directly await axios without error boundaries, so rejected requests are not surfaced consistently.
